title: Les Kassos
overview: يحكي مسلسل Les Kassos قصة Characters من أطفالنا الذين أصبحوا ضحايا الأزمة الاقتصادية. ومع ذلك، لا يزالون يحظون بمساعدة برافرة يرعاهم لاستعادة حياتهم. في مكتبه، يُحاور مع أشخاص مهمين من حياتهم السابقة، مثل Aspegix و Grodebilix، Zizimir، Sandy، Proumfs، Mr Patatos، Marius و Gigi، وتورتيلس ترامبز، جميعهم يعانون من غبطة كبيرة.

ai_content.desc_en: The Wakos is a story about characters from our childhood who became victims of the economic crisis. However, they are still fortunate to have a brave social worker who helps them regain their lives. In his office, the characters are interviewed by important people from their past lives, such as Aspegix and Grodebilix, Zizimir, Sandy, Proumfs, Mr Patatos, Marius and Gigi, and the Tortoises Tramps, all of whom suffer from great indifference.

ai_content.opinion_en: The Wakos is a poignant experience that shows the real impact of the economic crisis on characters from our childhood. The series highlights the effects of the crisis on the lives of characters.
